You washed ashore on Starroot Isle. The Heartseed story plays as cutscenes.

• Story: journal, claim rewards, cinematic pages
• Online: create room → QR share; friends scan or deep-link join
• Tile edits & sleep (crop growth) sync live online
• Local co-op, jobs, biomes, music/SFX as before

Original IP — no third-party characters or art.
